sql: SELECT n.primary_name AS actor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tg.genre_id) AS genre_count FROM names n JOIN principals p ON p.name_id = n.id JOIN titles t ON p.title_id = t.id JOIN titles_genres tg ON t.id = tg.title_id WHERE p.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') AND t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.num_votes > 10000 GROUP BY n.id, n.primary_name ORDER BY genre_count DESC, n.primary_name ASC
